claims.statement: Poland's e-Zamówienia platform exposes APIs for reading national procurement notices and statistics without an integration procedure.
The EU TED developer portal provides APIs, open data, and standards for searching and reusing procurement notices.

contrary_evidence: Free public APIs make the raw notice feed easy for competitors to copy.
General tender-alert vendors already cover broad procurement categories.

economics.acquisition_route: Unvalidated hypothesis: recruit contractors through installer associations, accountants, and free regional tender digests.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated hypothesis: 3,000 CEE contractor seats and proprietary price benchmarks could support a 5 million PLN founder net-worth path in six to nine years.
economics.founder_time: Unvalidated hypothesis: automated ingestion and one vertical keep founder work below 15 hours weekly.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated hypothesis: automated extraction could reach 85% gross margin before success-fee service, and every commercial number including capital_required_pln is hypothetical.
economics.payback: Unvalidated hypothesis: acquisition pays back within two subscription months.
economics.pricing: Unvalidated hypothesis: charge 900 PLN monthly per contractor plus 0.4% of won contract value.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Unvalidated hypothesis: daily notices, award tracking, and accumulated bid benchmarks create repeat use.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: A private tender-to-bid-to-award graph learns real pricing, competitors, subcontractors, and win conditions
fingerprint.customer: Small energy-retrofit, HVAC, photovoltaic, and electrical contractors
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Free regional digests and installer-association referrals
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Scored alerts, tender document extraction, bid/no-bid support, and award benchmark subscription
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: The contractor pays for continuous intelligence and optionally when a tracked bid wins
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A relevant public project appears before the contractor has allocated estimating resources

founder_fit: This is a low-capital data product that can be tested inside the family business workflow.
Automated distribution avoids personal-brand and camera dependence.
risks: Customers may withhold the private cost and outcome data needed for defensibility.
Success fees may require careful contracting to avoid procurement conflicts.

structure.control_point: Scored opportunity alert and private bid decision record before the contractor commits estimating time
structure.critical_dependency: Stable public procurement feeds and customer submission of bid costs and outcomes

thesis: Turn Polish and EU procurement notices into an early retrofit opportunity feed and proprietary contractor bid-outcome database.
title: Energy-Retrofit Tender Intelligence Ledger
uncertainties: The incremental value of vertical scoring over existing alerts is unverified.
All commercial numbers including capital_required_pln are unvalidated hypotheses.
